Hi Emma — great to reconnect after last week's call.

We want to get a short exec-level demo on the calendar with your CFO + CTO and follow with an optional deeper technical session for engineers. With stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, DST offsets have been tripping up proposed times — apologies if any earlier invites showed inconsistent local times.

To make scheduling easier, here are three candidate approaches (local times + UTC):

Option 1 — Single slot (exec + tech same meeting):
- Tue May 18, 09:00 PT / 17:00 BST / 01:00 JST (+1) — 09:00 PT (UTC-7), 17:00 BST (UTC+1), 01:00 JST (UTC+9 next day)
- Pros: everyone together, simplest for Q&A
- Cons: late for APAC execs

Option 2 — Split sessions (exec first, tech after):
- Exec: 45 min — 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST / 00:00 JST (+1)
- Tech deep-dive: 60 min — scheduled separately at an APAC-friendly day/time or recorded for playback
- Pros: respects exec calendar constraints, keeps tech workstreams separate

Option 3 — Rotating cadence (fairness over multiple meetings):
- Week 1: US-friendly slot; Week 2: EU-friendly; Week 3: APAC-friendly
- Pros: equitable over time, good for ongoing syncs

Can you confirm which approach you prefer and whether any of the specific times above work for CFO / CTO? If helpful I can propose exact calendar invites and include a brief agenda (attached: agenda-v2.pdf) and the draft mutual action plan.

Thanks — will loop Laura and Neha for logistics once we lock the approach.

Best,
Soojin
